# Control ModernAvatar
Part of the control family React.

Control creation keywords:
```yaml
Control: ModernAvatar
```

Input Properties:
  - AccessibleLabel: Text
      Default: ""
  - Appearance: Enum
      Default: AvatarColor.Brand
      Enum name: AvatarColor
      Enum values: Anchor, Beige, Blue, Brand, Brass, Brown, Cornflower, Cranberry, DarkGreen, DarkRed, Forest, Gold, Grape, Lavender, LightTeal, Lilac, Magenta, Marigold, Mink, Navy, Peach, Pink, Platinum, Plum, Pumpkin, Purple, Red, RoyalBlue, Seafoam, Steel, Teal
  - Badge: Enum
      Default: PresenceBadge.Available
      Enum name: PresenceBadge
      Enum values: Available, Away, Blocked, Busy, Do not disturb, None, Offline, Out of office, Unknown
  - BasePaletteColor: Color
  - BorderColor: Color
  - BorderStyle: Enum
      Default: ""
      Enum name: BorderStyle
      Enum values: Dashed, Dotted, None, Solid
  - BorderThickness: Number
  - Color: Color
  - ContentLanguage: Text
      Default: ""
  - DisplayMode: Enum
      Default: DisplayMode.Edit
      Enum name: DisplayMode
      Enum values: Disabled, Edit, View
  - Fill: Color
  - Font: Enum
      Default: ""
      Enum name: Font
      Enum values: Arial, Courier New, Dancing Script, Georgia, Great Vibes, Lato, Lato Black, Lato Hairline, Lato Light, Open Sans, Open Sans Condensed, Patrick Hand, Segoe UI, Verdana
  - FontWeight: Enum
      Enum name: FontWeight
      Enum values: Bold, Lighter, Normal, Semibold
  - Height: Number
      Default: 64
  - Image: Image
      Default: User().Image
  - Italic: Boolean
      Default: false
  - Name: Text
      Default: User().FullName
  - OnSelect: Boolean
      Default: false
  - PaddingBottom: Number
      Default: 0
  - PaddingLeft: Number
      Default: 0
  - PaddingRight: Number
      Default: 0
  - PaddingTop: Number
      Default: 0
  - RadiusBottomLeft: Number
  - RadiusBottomRight: Number
  - RadiusTopLeft: Number
  - RadiusTopRight: Number
  - Shape: Enum
      Default: AvatarShape.Circular
      Enum name: AvatarShape
      Enum values: Circular, Square
  - Size: Number
      Default: 0
  - Strikethrough: Boolean
      Default: false
  - Tooltip: Text
      Default: ""
  - Underline: Boolean
      Default: false
  - Visible: Boolean
      Default: true
  - Width: Number
      Default: 64
  - X: Number
      Default: 0
  - Y: Number
      Default: 0

Additional input properties if a child of a Vertical or Horizontal GroupContainer:
  - AlignInContainer: Enum
      Default: AlignInContainer.SetByContainer
      Enum name: AlignInContainer
      Enum values: Center, End, SetByContainer, Start, Stretch
  - FillPortions: Number
      Default: 0
  - LayoutMaxHeight: Number
      Default: 0
  - LayoutMaxWidth: Number
      Default: 0
  - LayoutMinHeight: Number
      Default: 64
  - LayoutMinWidth: Number
      Default: 64

Additional input properties if a child of a Grid GroupContainer:
  - LayoutGridColumnEnd: Number
  - LayoutGridColumnStart: Number
  - LayoutGridRowEnd: Number
  - LayoutGridRowStart: Number

Output Properties:
  - AccessibleLabel: Text
  - BasePaletteColor: Color
  - BorderColor: Color
  - BorderStyle: Enum
  - BorderThickness: Number
  - Color: Color
  - ContentLanguage: Text
  - DisplayMode: Enum
  - Fill: Color
  - Font: Enum
  - FontWeight: Enum
  - Height: Number
  - Italic: Boolean
  - PaddingBottom: Number
  - PaddingLeft: Number
  - PaddingRight: Number
  - PaddingTop: Number
  - RadiusBottomLeft: Number
  - RadiusBottomRight: Number
  - RadiusTopLeft: Number
  - RadiusTopRight: Number
  - Size: Number
  - Strikethrough: Boolean
  - Tooltip: Text
  - Underline: Boolean
  - Visible: Boolean
  - Width: Number
  - X: Number
  - Y: Number
